description: A kind of legal/compliance document tracked in the register (Commercial Registration, Iqama, Municipal License…). Perpetual types (Title Deed, VAT) never expire and are excluded from expiry reminders.

fields.description: A perpetual document never expires (e.g. Title Deed صك, VAT registration). Register rows of this type carry no expiry date and never trigger a renewal reminder.
fields.label: Perpetual (never expires)

fields.description: This document is renewed periodically (enables the Renew action on register rows).
fields.label: Renewable

fields.description: The entity this document normally belongs to — pre-selects the register row's Entity Type. Blank = any.
fields.label: Applies To
fields.options:
Company
Customer
Supplier
Property
Lease Contract
Land

fields.description: Optional convenience: default validity in months, used to pre-fill a register row's expiry from its issue date.
fields.label: Default Validity (months)

fields.description: Reminder lead days before expiry, comma-separated (e.g. '90,30,7,0'; 0 = on the expiry day). Blank uses the system default (90,30,7,0).
fields.label: Reminder Days

fields.description: Grace period (days) a document stays legally usable AFTER expiry (e.g. Iqama). During grace the register shows 'In Grace' and a single grace alert is sent. 0 = no grace.
fields.label: Grace Period (days)

name: RE Document Type
